events.description: New faculty orientation throughout the week. Seminars and meetings across campus and disciplines.

events.title: Last day of class for Summer Session 2
Staff and Faculty CommuniTEA
events.description:
Staff and faculty are invited to attend CommuniTEA. Every Wednesday during the summer, the Lutheran Center hosts CommuniTEA. This is a chance for you to unwind, color, relax, and drink tea — the space is yours to come and just be. The Lutheran Center will provide the tea.

CommuniTea will take place between Tomson and the wind chimes. During inclement weather, it will be held in the Lutheran Center.

Faculty meetings are open to all voting members of the faculty. See this webpage for more details regarding the voting franchise.

Opening Convocation
events.description: All students, families, faculty, and staff are welcome to attend Opening Convocation at Boe Chapel to start the new school year. The St. Olaf Band, conducted by Assistant Professor of Music Henry L. Dorn, will perform.

events.title: First Day of Classes Garden Party
events.description:
Faculty and staff are invited to President Susan Rundell Singer’s residence, the St. Olaf House, to celebrate the first day of classes of the 2026–27 academic year. Beverages and hors d’oeuvres will be provided.

** In the case of inclement weather, this event will be held in the Buntrock Commons Ballrooms **
